input.overview: Vegas builds bonus through the five top lanes and the lit center-side rollovers. Reach 2X to light the spinner, and hit the lane target repeatedly: its second hit advances the multiplier, third lights Special, and fourth lights Shoot Again. Hit the save-ball target early so the side kicker can return a ball from its lane.
input.simpleOverview: In Vegas, hit the save-ball target early to activate the side-lane kicker. Use the five top lanes and lit center-side rollovers to build bonus; reaching 2X lights the spinner. Hit the lane target twice to advance the multiplier, a third time to light Special, and a fourth time to light Shoot Again.
input.summary: The lane target is the clearest escalating route, but light the save-ball kicker first. Feed the upper lanes to raise the multiplier and enable bonus rollovers, then use the spinner after 2X lights. Lit center-side rollovers advance bonus and move the Special lamp.

quickInfo.name: Save-ball target
quickInfo.summary: Hit it to light the side-lane kicker; the kicker returns a ball only while Save Ball is lit.

quickInfo.name: Lane target
quickInfo.summary: The second hit advances the multiplier, the third lights Special, and the fourth lights Shoot Again.

quickInfo.name: Top lanes
quickInfo.summary: The five numbered lanes light for the current ball, raise the multiplier, and enable the upper bonus rollovers.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinner
quickInfo.summary: Reaching 2X Bonus lights the spinner for its higher value.

steps.text: Shoot the save-ball target before taking repeated risks near the side kicker lane.
Send the ball through unlit top lanes 1–5 to raise the bonus multiplier and light the upper bonus rollovers.
Hit the lane target twice for another multiplier advance, then continue for Special and Shoot Again if the feed remains safe.
After 2X lights, use the spinner as the repeatable scoring shot.
Take lit center-side rollovers to advance bonus and move the Special lamp, but do not chase a dangerous rollover merely to rotate it.
Light Save Ball at its target.
Advance the multiplier through top lanes or the lane target.
Shoot the spinner after 2X lights, then continue toward the lane-target Shoot Again.

techniques.name: Aiming and shooting
techniques.instruction: Use a repeatable release point for the narrow lane target; its second, third and fourth hits are worth more than a wide spray across the center.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play, Shoot Again and Special conversions, replay thresholds, and whether the save-ball kicker and its lamp are enabled and strong.
Test all five top lanes and lamps, multiplier steps, center-side bonus rollovers, lane target hit count, save-ball target and kicker lane, spinner lighting at 2X, three bumpers, and tilt behavior.

playfieldReferences.description: Target with escalating second-, third- and fourth-hit awards.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus spinner
playfieldReferences.description: Spinner that gains its higher value when 2X Bonus is lit.
